findings.description: The comparison presented Cilium/Calico as unconditional current choices for every Hybrid node.
findings.resolution: Scope this comparison to the current AWS-maintained Cilium path; existing Calico deployments require separate support checking.
findings.initialExcerpt: The VPC CNI is not compatible with hybrid nodes, so **hybrid nodes always run Cilium (or Calico).** The question "Cilium only or mixed with the VPC CNI?" is therefore really about **whether the cluster has cloud nodes, and if so, which CNI they run.**

findings.description: Eviction was said to stop whenever every node in one zone was unreachable, omitting ready nodes in another zone.
findings.resolution: Document the all-cluster-zero-ready cancellation and the other-zone-ready path, with thresholds/size conditions and link to detailed scenarios.
findings.initialExcerpt: | Zone label | If nodes carry `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`, Kubernetes cancels evictions for a zone when all nodes in that zone are unreachable. Hybrid nodes have no cloud-controller-manager, so set a per-data-center zone with nodeadm `--node-labels`. |

findings.description: The 300 second waiting period was assigned to Pods without a matching toleration.
findings.resolution: Attribute 300 seconds to default ordinary Pod NoExecute tolerations from taint application; no matching toleration permits immediate eviction, DaemonSet defaults differ, and old disconnected containers may continue.
findings.initialExcerpt: | Pod failover | Pods without a toleration are evicted by the control plane after the default 300 seconds and replacement pods are created on other nodes. DaemonSet pods tolerate this taint by default and stay on the node. |

findings.description: The AZ cost advice implied Gateway can select BGP for high volume and Gateway for webhooks sharing the same destinations.
findings.resolution: Describe BGP/static routing as an alternative, destination-prefix route ownership, disjoint ownership for combined designs, and explicit return-path verification.
findings.initialExcerpt: There is no gateway software charge. Count EC2, storage, Auto Mode management fees (only for gateway nodes running on Auto Mode), cross-AZ data transfer, private connectivity and observability as well as normal cluster/Hybrid Nodes costs. “Inside the same VPC” does not imply free cross-AZ transfer. Routing through another AZ can add traffic charges. There is only one active leader, so even with gateway nodes in several AZs, Hybrid traffic from Pods, ALBs or scrapers in other AZs crosses into the leader's AZ ([AWS operations guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/hybrid-nodes-gateway-operations.html)). For high-volume paths, route the Pod CIDRs directly with Cilium BGP so traffic leaves through the TGW/VGW in the Pod's own AZ, and keep the gateway for webhooks and low-volume Pod-to-Pod traffic.

findings.description: One remaining Gateway Pod was treated as a traffic-stop condition even if it was healthy.
findings.resolution: Traffic can continue through a healthy sole leader without redundancy; stop cases are its failure or both replica failures, until repair/operator intervention.
findings.initialExcerpt: If only one gateway Pod exists, or both fail, Pod traffic between the VPC and the Hybrid Pod CIDRs of **all** data centers stops together. The runtime never calls `DeleteRoute`, so VPC routes keep pointing at the failed ENI.

findings.description: NodePort SNAT and underlay source/return routing were presented as universal.
findings.resolution: Scope node SNAT to the reported lab and require checking Service policy, dataplane, masquerade, observed source IP and return route.
findings.initialExcerpt: | On-premises → Hybrid NodePort → VPC CNI Pod | kube-proxy SNATs to the node IP and host routing sends it over the underlay, so the gateway (VTEP) is not used. Region node security groups must allow the app port from the remote node CIDR | Failed (cluster SG allowed only 443 from the remote node CIDR) |

findings.description: The simulated TGW reverse-path lab was labelled as twice traversing Direct Connect.
findings.resolution: State twice traversing the private connection and assess the production DX/VPN design separately.
findings.initialExcerpt: | On-premises → internal ALB → Hybrid Pod | The same path plus a hairpin back to on-premises through the gateway; it crosses DX twice, adding latency and transfer cost | 20/20 |
